seo_intro:
GTA 6 (GTA6) facts most players don't know, before the November 19, 2026 release.
The first GTA 6 trailer set a 24-hour YouTube record, the game arrives 13 years after GTA 5 (230M+ copies sold), it's set in Leonida, home of Vice City, and 90 clips of early footage leaked in 2022.
sources: Guinness World Records / Push Square — GTA 6 trailer: 90,421,491 YouTube views in 24 hours (Dec 2023)
Game Developer — GTA V surpasses 230 million sales (Take-Two, May 2026)
GameSpot / NME — Rockstar confirms the September 2022 leak (90 videos), work to continue as planned
Tom's Guide / ESPN — GTA 6 delayed to May 26, 2026, then to November 19, 2026
sources_text: Guinness World Records; Take-Two (via Game Developer); Rockstar Games statements (via GameSpot, NME); Tom's Guide; ESPN.
